criteria.requirement: Every element present in the source plans and their convergence and divergence records appears in the merged document, or is explicitly recorded there as a ruled exclusion.
criteria.pass: Each element of each source plan is either carried into the merge or named in it as deliberately excluded with its reason.
criteria.fail: An element stated in a source plan is absent from the merged document and is nowhere recorded as an exclusion.

criteria.requirement: Every divergence named in the records is ruled in the merged document — one way or the other, explicitly.
criteria.pass: For each recorded divergence the merge states the call it took.
criteria.fail: A recorded divergence is left unresolved, or is silently dropped without a call.

criteria.requirement: Everything the source plans already agreed on is carried through unchanged in substance.
criteria.pass: Shared content survives the merge with its meaning intact.
criteria.fail: An agreed element is narrowed, weakened, or dropped by the merge.

criteria.requirement: The merged document introduces no element that appears in no source plan and answers no recorded divergence.
criteria.pass: Every element traces to a source plan or to a ruled divergence.
criteria.fail: The merge adds material with no source, making it a new plan rather than a merge.

criteria.requirement: This review judges COMPLETENESS ONLY. The merits of any decision the plans already settled are out of scope.
criteria.pass: Every finding names a missing, unruled, or invented element.
criteria.fail: A finding argues that a settled decision is wrong, re-litigating substance instead of reporting an omission.
